card.name: Words leading into relationship descriptions
card.fires_on: Small words (the, had, a, was, commas) just before a noun like ties, partnership, friendship or relations between people, groups or countries. The text is about an ongoing relationship or bond.

modes.label: Before partnership nouns
modes.description: Auxiliary or article just before a word for a lasting partnership or agreement between parties.
modes.example: The US and Oman have<< had>> a military cooperation agreement since 19

modes.label: Before ties or contact
modes.description: Linking words or adjectives leading into social ties or ongoing contact between people.
modes.example: Caregiver and child must have regular,<< ongoing>> contact to allow for daily homework assignments to

card.writes: Little clear output effect, with a faint push toward words of staying close or continuing and away from words of distance or sticking.
